items.title: Establish the Linux unofficial isolated-home contract
acceptance: ADR 0007 authorizes version-scoped black-box isolation while production capabilities remain gated.
Synthetic profiles receive distinct cleared environments and unsafe roots fail closed.

verification.command: python3 scripts/check.py && cargo deny check; synthetic isolation tests; strict harness validation
verification.outcome: passing; 35 tests, dependency policy, distinct environments, unsafe-root refusal, and context budgets

items.title: Implement the TTY-preserving isolated launcher
acceptance: Interactive children inherit standard streams while ambient environment variables remain cleared.
Arguments bypass the shell and the exact child exit status is returned.
Only a conservatively validated TERM value extends the environment allowlist.
Fake-client tests cover environment, argv, terminal validation, and nonzero exit behavior.
Two disposable isolated homes safely probe installed agy 1.1.2 with --version only.
